excluded_passages.why: Developers 'will be required to conduct regular testing to determine whether a model would pose a potential risk of loss of control': a test, with no record or report named, so not a signal by the codebook.
Serious-incident reporting for high-risk AI systems, a duty the Act sets apart from general-purpose models; out by the codebook.
Public summary of training content: about data and copyright, out by the codebook.
Notice to users of generative AI (Art. 31) and duties for high-impact AI in listed domains (Art. 34), which the Act sets apart from the compute-threshold duty of Art. 32.
A duty to inform individuals that they deal with an agent; out by the codebook.
